cases.title: 2D threshold update matches explicit greatest-fixed-point oracle
cases.oracle: Enumerate the six product-grid states, repeatedly remove every safe state without an action whose two successors remain in the current safe set, and compare the resulting boolean mask with the threshold representation.
cases.claim_ceiling: Small finite monotone-grid algorithm semantics only.

cases.title: Reject a non-lower-closed initial safe set
cases.oracle: In componentwise order, the threshold at column x=0 must be at least the threshold at x=1; 0 < 1 violates lower-closedness.

cases.title: Reject malformed affine transition-rule dimensions
cases.oracle: A d-dimensional transition rule must define exactly d output rows and d offsets.

cases.title: Column cap produces BOUNDED without partial threshold output
cases.oracle: The declared column count exceeds the explicit cap before fixed-point evaluation begins.

cases.title: 8-million-state product grid stored as 40,000 column thresholds
cases.oracle: Identity transitions make every state in the lower-closed initial safe set remain in the set; the threshold frontier is unchanged.
cases.claim_ceiling: Source-level test fixture and algorithmic representation only. Runtime/memory measurements and scale superiority are not yet established.

cases.title: 160 generated lower-closed 2D grids match explicit greatest-fixed-point oracle
cases.oracle: For each generated non-negative affine saturating rule and each lower-closed initial threshold pair, enumerate all six grid states and perform explicit greatest-fixed-point removal; compare the resulting set with the compressed threshold solver.
cases.claim_ceiling: Finite algorithmic equivalence on this generated monotone 2D family only; no performance or physical-model claim.
